title: Infant formula, Gerber Good Start Gentle, Stage 2 (353)

content.title: About
content.content: Gerber Good Start Gentle Stage 2 is an infant formula for babies 6–12 months old, formulated with partially hydrolyzed cow's milk protein. The blend includes prebiotics, DHA, ARA, and iron to support growth, brain development, and immune health during the transition from breast‑milk to solid foods.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Designed for infants who need a gentler protein source than standard cow‑milk formulas.
Partially hydrolyzed protein reduces the risk of cow‑milk protein allergy.
Prebiotic GOS promotes a healthy gut microbiome.
DHA and ARA are essential fatty acids for brain and eye development.
No artificial flavors or colors are added.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: Provides a balanced mix of protein, fat, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals needed for infant growth.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA contribute to the formation of neural cells and visual acuity.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: GOS prebiotics stimulate beneficial bacteria, improving digestion.

items.title: Reduced allergy risk
items.content: Partial hydrolysis makes the protein less allergenic compared with intact cow‑milk protein.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Enriched with iron and vitamins A, C, D, which play roles in immune function.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Some infants may still react; discontinue use and consult a pediatrician if symptoms appear.

items.title: Improper mixing
items.content: Over‑concentrated formula can strain the kidneys; follow the manufacturer’s mixing instructions.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Use opened container within 48 hours and keep it refrigerated.

items.title: Iron overload
items.content: Excess iron may cause constipation; monitor intake and seek medical advice if needed.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with warm (about 37 °C) water. Stir thoroughly until smooth, avoiding lumps. The prepared feed should be used immediately.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry powder in its original airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 48 hours and keep refrigerated.
